name: prop_flow
description: The static prop/weapon pipeline: concept image -> Pixal3D mesh -> quad remesh (10K, prop preset) -> 8 turntable views. Ultra-low polygon budget for props, furniture, weapons, environment pieces. No rig stage. Composes the image and 3d cards internally. These lanes are AGENT-DRIVEN card chains (2026-09-04 flows rework): drive each stage card through the queue door ({model: ...}); there is no single-shot yaml door anymore (docs/queue/flows.md).

prompt.description: Concept prompt when no image is supplied - flat background, full silhouette.

face_budget.description: Quad target for the remesh stage. Default 10000 (ultra-low).
